review_highlights_json.text: Great chill bar in Houston, the beer selection is nice and I like the drinks! The bar food is great! The frozen drinks will get you on a new level!

I was invited to this place by my grieve Nick who currently works there. The place is my type of vibe..extremely cute! There's indoor & outdoor seating. Indoor is very classic with a jukebox, fooz ball table, pool table, & AND arcade video games which includes Ms Pac Man, ping pong machine, & my personal favorite Street Fighter!! The outdoor has a view of a railroad with active trains. The food was 10/10!! And service was great thanks to Mark! I highly recommend going
Cool bar you can sit in or outside . Was there for traphouse wrestling free shows . Drinks are great , food from bar or from a vendor has been good everything. Only minus is parking .

I got the quesadilla and added  beef fajita and it was very good. They had quite a few TVs and a pool table with a couple other games. Definitely a cool spot and all of us were pleasantly surprised with how good the food was.

If excellence were a cocktail, Tran and Krystal would be the top-shelf liquor, the perfect garnish, and the sparkle on the rim. These two aren’t just bartenders: they are cultural icons, national treasures, and frankly, should be running for president on a joint ticket. Hot? Obviously. Funny? Baby, they’ve got more punchlines than the well has lime juice. Iconic? The word was invented for them.

When they pour, they pour charisma. When they laugh, the whole bar lights up brighter than a disco ball at Studio 54. They don’t just serve drinks, they serve LIFE, darling. Walking into this bar and seeing Tran and Krystal behind the counter is like being welcomed to the main stage of Kuntry Kitchen Jeopardy: category is… legendary hospitality realness.

Tip them well. Tip them always. Because when you’re in their hands, honey you’re not just drinking, you’re living. Can I get an amen?

review_highlights_json.text: Beautiful New place to just hang around have a couple of drinks, staff are on top of their game making sure everyone is taken care of, and more importantly clean and spacious bathrooms 🤣
Great place to hang out perfect to have fun, great customer service and service
nice place staff there so friendly prices not expensive at all so I recommend 100
I love the music great place to hang out☺️
Fun place to have drinks an dance!

We came here for a birthday dinner. I called ahead for a reservation  and had to hold for a few minutes, but the person taking my reservation was friendly and helpful.

I think they have valet parking but we didn't see them.  We dined inside on a weeknight.

We started with a mimosa and a glass of Champagne. They have an impressive list of custom cocktails and some nice wines.  We asked them to dilute the mimosa with more OJ and they brought us a fresh one; the Perrier Jouet Champagne by the glass was excellent and I thoughtit quite reasonable at $28 / glass.  The first course were some East Coast oysters, and a salad.  The food was excellent - the oysters were fresh and they identified each one and its region; the salad was very good although the large butter lettuce pieces required a bit of cutting and chopping down. We then had the fettuccine and clams, Halibut grilled,  cauliflower, and grits. All of the main items were very good, fresh, flavorful and spot on.  The fettuccine and clams dish was requested to be made not spicy, and they accommodated us gladly - very eager to please. The service from Lorenzo was excellent even though he had 5 tables, and it was nice to see that the servers worked as a team.   We were too full for dessert but their selections sounded divine.  Total with tax and drinks was $194. It was very nice... we will return.  I gave the atmosphere 1 less star because on the tables with white tablecloths they put butcher paper on top... I find that tacky.

It's a little pricey but the food, service, and atmosphere are all on point. They always have a great oyster selection (wouldn't mind more northwestern ones)! The cocktails are great. The happy hour is good (half priced martinis are great! $0.50 off oysters is a little disappointing). I can't believe I'm saying this as they're a seafood restaurant, but they might have my favorite burger in the city (half off during happy hour). Thick and juicy and delicious. Also, the lobster roll is EXCELLENT and priced similarly to what you might get from a food truck but higher quality.

We had Kat as our server and she was phenomenal. I recommend any one that goes to request her. She was knowledgeable over the food & made great suggestions when we gave her our likes & dislikes! And even got us a mocktail that wasn’t on the menu. It don’t take much to make a night worth rememebering and she did just that with her awesome personality! On top of that the food was also delicious it all melts right in your mouth. 10/10 will be returning

We were greeted with warm sourdough bread and fresh butter once seated — a great start. We ordered the redfish ceviche, which was absolutely delicious, though for the price I would have expected homemade tortilla chips instead of saltines. I also had a bowl of New England clam chowder, hearty and full of clams and potatoes. For my main, the Cobb salad was outstanding: bold flavors, heavy on the blue cheese, and topped with incredible homemade bacon. OH MY.

My wife had the tuna salad sandwich on fresh sourdough, which she loved. The bread was fantastic, but the shoestring fries were a miss — more like over-fried potato toothpicks than fries. My daughter ordered the redfish on the half shell with a spinach salad and couldn’t stop talking about the glaze on the fish.

What really stood out was our waitress. She more than made up for the fries and crackers with her warm service — attentive to every need and clearly knew the menu like the back of her hand.

Overall, Clark’s serves up fresh, high-quality seafood and memorable dishes, with just a couple of small tweaks that could take it from very good to truly exceptional.

Mike “Big Chief” Hiatt
The Whiskey Trip Podcast

Clark’s Oyster Bar was incredible! Their variety of oysters was absolutely delicious — we tried one of each and loved them all. The tuna carpaccio and octopus were both top-notch, perfectly prepared, and full of flavor. The service was excellent, and the atmosphere was classy yet relaxed. We’ll definitely be coming back soon! Plus, they offer valet parking, which makes the whole experience even more convenient. Highly recommend!

Service 10/10 EMILY WAS AWESOME!

review_highlights_json.text: Have a dinner here in August 2025. This place was a hidden gem. Wasn't sure where it was located until I realized it was inside the hotel. The decor is appropriate for the location. Service was exceptional. The waiter who waited on me was attentive and paid attention to the details. The setup is cozy and well arranged. I great place for small groups and dates and the ambiance is fitting. This was during Restaurant Week so there was a special multicourse menu. The drinks and the food choices matched what we ordered and the presentation was equally good. I would definitely recommend this place for easy quiet paced dinner and conversation. Definitely will revisit.

Little hidden gem in the heart of Montrose! We pass by this place all the time, but we never noticed it because of the amazing privacy bushes... it's a positive though as the window seating will allow a nice atmosphere that separates the city life from this haven of delight. We planned a nice date-night dinner here as a precursor to a show at Stages. The staff was very attentive and courteous, complementary valet service, beautiful and very clean facility retaining the history of the original structure! The food was also amazing! We started off with a cold dish which was just as visually appetizing as it tasted (Crown Toro Hamachi Tartare)... I could eat several plates of this alone!!! The lovely wife had the Gnocchi al Tartufo which was filling and warmed the soul. I had the Roasted Duck Breast, which was cooked perfectly! The polenta was rich/creamy and paired with the duck nicely. The sauce was welcomed and went perfectly with the duck. We finished our journey there by sharing the Banana Semifreddo! Not only does it look like art, but it was a treat to finish off... try to pace yourself because your willpower to scarf it down will be tested. All-in-all, this was a pleasurable experience and we are excited to come back to try more dishes! Highly recommend!

Restaurant is really nice and delicious. Valet people need training. They don’t know how to drive. They drove my jeep with the handbrake! I picked up my jeep and it smelled terrible to smoke. If you don’t know how to drive it don’t take it!

Im editing this about an hour after I posted the text above because I was just informed that my colleague who was with me had her car brought to the ramp with a flat tire. Apparently the valet drove her car into a ditch and got her tire busted. The guys did not let her talk to a manager and stood right in front of the main door to block her. I recommended she talk to police because this is insane. The restaurant should look into these guys running the valet service today March 9th (6-10pm). Terrible!
This is a very beautiful restaurant with a classical piano, oil painting walls, crystal lamps, and a beautiful back garden. Everything is very gorgeous.

food was amazing, service was smooth, and the place itself is beautiful.

Be prepared to spend a little — if you’re not about quality, this spot might not be for you. But for us, the price was more than fair for the presentation, atmosphere, and overall experience.

I’ll definitely be bringing my wife here next

review_highlights_json.text:
We had a wonderful brunch experience at Grace’s on Sunday! From start to finish, everything was excellent. Armando, our server, was fantastic—friendly, attentive, and full of great recommendations that did not disappoint.

We started with the jalapeño cornbread, which was a perfect kickoff to the meal. For our mains, we ordered the chicken and waffles and the jalapeño steak, and both were absolutely delicious—flavorful, well-prepared, and incredibly satisfying.

The food, service, and overall experience were top-notch. We can’t wait to come back and visit Grace’s again!

Great service, and the food was great. We went for brunch. We had to wait a bit but didn’t mind. My table got the steak and eggs dish, and the shrimp and grits.  Everything was tasty. The complimentary cornbread was delightful. It was not as dense as I expected, more of an airy texture, and a little spicy. It paired nicely with the honey butter. We loved the frozen mimosas with the pomegranate swirl.

Went here with my family for my birthday 🥳.  Glad I made reservations, because the restaurant was very busy (after 5pm). The host was nice. Our food took a while to come out. I had the Cajun Stuffed Chicken with Mac and cheese and collard greens. Everything was good on my plate except the collard greens.  They could use more flavor in my opinion. Our waiter, Kodi, was nice and brought out a birthday dessert 🍰 with a candle lit😊. The patio seating area is lovely. I think we will sit out there next go round and check out the brunch menu.

Alan has World Class Customer Service. Very polite and listens to your order. Made a great suggestion on the Specials of the Day. We ordered the beef tips and rice and had a side black eye peas that are absolutely delicious. We came hungry but left extremely full. The food is so good if I was RICH I would tip all the cooks in the kitchen $1,000.00 each. Yes each that is how good no let me rephrase that. That is how Great and Awesome the food and service is. This is my husband and I second time here and we are very thankful someone hires the right staff. We were greeted walking in and the rest was outstanding.

"A Birthday Dinner Done Right: Flavor, Service, and Vibes at Grace’s" (Oct. 25, 2025)

Even though this review is overdue, Grace’s is 100% worth the praise. My family celebrated my daughter's 26th birthday here (party of 10), and everything from the reservation to the final sip, was smooth and impressive. We were seated right away, and our server, Bradley, was professional, warm, and attentive without ever rushing us.

The ambiance is perfect for conversation: dim lighting, soft music, and a relaxed upscale vibe. The menu blends Italian, Creole, and American influences (with Sicilian + Louisiana roots), and the food was beautifully plated and packed with flavor.

Highlights (all 5/5): Jimmy G’s Seafood Platter, complimentary cast iron cornbread, shrimp-stuffed poblano, fajita steak y enchilada, smoked Philly cheesesteak, Les Allison's shrimp tacos, baked potato dip (appetizer), and the frozen margarita with strawberry swirl.

Plenty of parking (garage next door), and the dress code feels smart-casual to semi-formal. The only downside is the 50-minute drive, if Grace’s opened in Cypress, I’d be there constantly. Highly recommend!

review_highlights_json.text:
My boyfriend and I came here for a date night. The hostess, Isabelle, was very nice and seated us immediately. We asked to sit outside since the weather was nice, and the patio was very clean.

Our server was Demi, and she was so sweet, personable, and made great recommendations. Her personality was through the roof. She kept us entertained, and was attentive to when we needed another round of drinks.

We got the Mediterranean kabob plate as an appetizer, and it was delicious. My boyfriend got a ranch water, and I got a blue jeans & bow ties cocktail. They were all very good!

The manager, Ozgar, checked in on us throughout our meal and was very kind as well. I've never seen a manager check in on so many tables on such a busy night! He was very attentive.

Overall, we would 1000% come back and specifically ask for Demi. Thank you Demi and team for enhancing our date night!

I was actually insanely impressed. I’ve been in this area for 3 years and I’m actually pretty pissed I’ve been missing out on this gem. The food was so flavorful. Literally a 10 out of 10. I had the expresso martini mocktail and it was so good. They have something on the menu for literally everyone. Service was also amazing! The waiter was so sweet and knowledgeable.

I’ve been coming to Hearsay Market Square since 2012, and even as the menu evolves, the quality, service, and cocktails have remained consistently stellar. My visit today was absolutely amazing.

It had been a few years since my last visit, but the bartender, Destiny, reminded me exactly why I love this place. Her customer service was top-notch. She guided me through trying new drinks and made excellent recommendations for my meal. I left happily full and buzzing in the best way!

Highly recommend, and I’m already looking forward to my next visit.

Great restaurant!  Food was great and the ambiance was very welcoming.  The staff were very helpful and always glad to help.  I ordered the grilled chicken sandwich which came with rosemary/salt fries.  The portion was good and all ingredients were fresh.  The fries had the coveted crunchy outside (but not too crunchy) and soft in the inside.

Recently had dinner & drinks here - food was a little disappointing considering I have been very satisfied with the food at a few other locations.
Salmon & bread pudding dessert was just ok.  My sweet potatoes were served cold.  The wine glasses need to be replaced.  Ahi tuna appetizer was delicious.

This place is just great. The food, service and atmosphere are all exceptional. You get a unique culinary experience in a contemporary, elevated space. I went last night for the second time on a friend-date, and we enjoyed the veal pasta, wagyu steak, scallop rockefeller, ricotta cheesecake, a few sides and a couple of drinks. Quality is amazing. The owner was also floating around and is so hospitable & passionate—you can tell he’s intentional about every detail of the place and menu. Thanks for taking care of us! Will definitely be back! Love the location, too.

I came across this gem while trying out the amazing pizza restaurant next-door. I saw they had a happy hour, which is one of my favorite activities and decided to meet up with a girlfriend to give it a try. Overall, I had a fabulous time and the atmosphere and restaurant is absolutely impeccable. Everything is clean, well laid out and the service was absolutely outstanding. I tried several of the bar bites, including the cheeseburger, pizza, truffle, fries, and fried okra. All were pretty good some a bit better than others but overall, I would say the star of the show was the cocktails. These were expertly crafted, incredibly delicious and presented beautifully

I recently enjoyed a delightful Sunday brunch at Fieldings with cousins, and it was a fantastic experience! Our server, Tabby, was exceptional—her menu suggestions were spot on, and she took the time to walk us through all the options, which we truly appreciated. The cocktail flight options (mimosas, bloody mary’s and coffee) were impressive, offering a great variety, and the food was simply delicious. We enjoyed the skillet bread (must order) and I had the avocado toast. The love entertainment (he takes requests) added an extra special touch to our visit. Let me not forget to mention the table side-prepared bananas foster.

I’m definitely planning to return, especially after the wonderful kitchen tour. I was pleasantly surprised when the restaurant followed up the next day to check on my experience. That thoughtful gesture really stood out to me and confirmed my desire to come back and enjoy another meal there.

O. M. G. Every dish and drink was flavorful, balanced, and beautifully presented! We had several appetizers—crab cake, oysters, and beet salad that aren’t pictured, but to die for! We had the ravioli and branzino for lunch—totally returning to this gem! Vibe and service were on point too! kudos to the chef and the entire team—5 stars!! 🥂❤️⭐️

My close friends treated me to lunch today at Fielding's for my birthday. It had a great ambience and though there was a decent crowd, it wasn't noisy.

The food selection was nice and had ample options to choose from for lunch. I had the Southwest turkey club with fries. It was a HUGE sandwich and I tend to have a big appetite, but only ate half...took the rest to go. I don't drink alcohol, but had a mocktail and the Lychee Breeze drink was tasty. For those who do drink they have 25 cent martinis (2 limit max per person) on Fridays from 11-3pm. Server was cool and attentive.

Loved the ease of valet ($8) vs having to park in the parking garage.

It was my first time eating here and I will more than likely be back. Glad to add another good spot to my list of go-to restaurants.

review_highlights_json.text: Came here to try the Dutch baby but didn’t see it on the menu, what we ended up ordering surprisingly delighted us. We loved pork collar, it was an explosion of flavors and textures, perfectly balanced and executed. We all enjoyed and crisp green salad, and waygu steak. The only dish we didn’t enjoy as much was the rigatoni with oxtail. All in all, food was delicious. However I took two off 2 stars off mainly because the water condensated on the ceiling interrupted our dining experience.

We came for dinner and found the food to be a bit hit and miss. My friend rates this place highly but even he agreed it wasn’t their best night and perhaps we didn’t choose the right dishes. Between the two of us, we shared the marinated mussels on bread (I didn't rate this - the mussels didn't feel very fresh), beetroot with endive, blue cheese (decent salad), dumplings with smoked eggplant, ricotta (this was more like tortellini rather than dumplings and it wasn't bad but the flavours clashed a bit) and the lamb ribs (the meat was dry and salty). Not a major issue but the order of the courses felt off as the mussels, a cold dish, were served last, after the warm dishes.
Really enjoyed brunch here. Was not super crowded for a Sunday and all of the food was delicious! The drinks did take a while but overall it’s a lovely place to grab some good food in the heights.

First, they have a parking lot, which is priceless in the Heights. Service was prompt and professional. We sat at the bar and it overlooked the outside patio, which appeared spacious (and it's covered).

My favorite part was their mocktail menu. So nice to have happy hour with friends and not be relegated to just drinking a soda.

We visited to try the Dutch baby, and it absolutely lived up to the hype—light, fluffy, and perfectly cooked. The fried chicken was impressively crispy with a bright lemony flavor that kept it fresh and unique. The atmosphere was laid-back, and the patio was pleasantly cool. With our reservation, we were seated immediately, making the whole experience smooth and enjoyable. A great spot for both comfort food and a relaxing outing.

Dope food, kind service, chill vibe.

From the dimily lit, well-spaced out patio to the small 4 table nook in the front and compact bar adjacent the open-faced kitchen, this spot definitely had a vibe.

Menu is lite bites, seemingly preferable for lunch or a lite dinner - but they pack a punch in flavor, only missing some spice to keep the scoville units satisfied 🔥

Large and creative drink menu, with classics to choose from, as well.

The atmosphere was outstanding. Our waiter, Joshua, provided exceptional service. The food was exquisite, particularly the Chicken and Mozzarella Panni, which was bursting with flavor. The crisp cauliflower was cooked nicely and the sauce was tasty. The BRUSCHETTA platter was also impressive, with each item being delicious. I would strongly recommend this restaurant.

I loved the mushroom and truffle cheese, it was absolutely delicious! They also have an amazing promotion on Mondays and Tuesdays: when you order a bottle of wine, you get to enjoy some appetizers. Everything is great, definitely a place worth coming back to. 🍷✨

I came early to my reservation (party of 5) and was greeted by Matthew who was exceptionally knowledgeable and enthused by all things Postino. I didn’t have to wait for the entire party to arrive to be seated which is an extreme plus. Not only did Matthew get all five of us to try things out of our comfort zone but he also attended to us quickly with the utmost consideration (after fact gathering what we generally like/dislike to eat).

I seriously enjoyed the sweet pepper and goat cheese bruschetta on gluten free bread. The smoked salmon was chef’s kiss as well.

Matthew it’s people like you that make a place stand out and shine. He was a savant of all things wine, food and hospitality. You felt like family and you made Postino feel like home. We cannot wait to come back and try more things on the menu.
It’s a really nice place, I love what they offer. Just not what I was looking for. I wanted pasta and or authentic Italian pizza. But either way it was delicious. I will definitely comeback.

We visited this location for lunch and the spot is super cute and beautifully decorated. We were seated on the patio, which has a nice vibe, but it felt a bit crowded since the tables are pretty close together. We happened to sit near a group that was extremely loud, and the noise echoed throughout the patio area 😅

For food, we ordered the tacos al carbón and the steak and eggs. I also had a watermelon margarita. Overall, everything was decent, but nothing really stood out. I’d rate the experience a 6/10.

Levi Goode, like his late father, has an excellent eye for design and detail and for me, as a native Houstonian, it is always such a pleasure to visit one of the Goode restaurants to see the themed decoration of the interior.

Been coming to these restaurants since their incarnation, with that original barbecue location on Kirby Drive. How many years ago? Over fifty possibly?

The chips and salsa were good. Enjoyed with my drink of choice, the uber carbonated Topo Chico in the bottle. Coca-Cola didn’t mess with the carbonation when they bought the company.

At the Yale location, a wall with the decorative wooden plates of Michoacán. I own just one. I count 18 on one wall. But one day, when we move into assisted living, I am going to contact Levi to see if he wants to buy our extensive collection of Mexican folk art. I especially think he will love taking ownership of my collection of Huichol masks. (I hope).

A person on Houston Heights foodies recommended the enchiladas saying that they were to die for and so, today, for lunch that is what I chose to have.

Evaluation? The rice was acceptable, the charro beans were good, the plate was hot, and the enchiladas were classically Tex-Mex and fresh tasting. I had been worried that everything would have a creosote mesquite smokiness, but it didn’t. The beans had a hint of that creosote smell and taste, but not a deal breaker.  But I had a taste and left the rest.

Whereas an experience at their West Gray location was not memorable, I was pleased with my lunch here, today.

We visited Goode Co. Cantina in the Heights with a large group, and it was such a great experience! The food was excellent—fresh, flavorful, and beautifully done. The standout for me was the cucumber salad—crisp, refreshing, and full of flavor. Despite our group size, the service was impressively fast and friendly, keeping everything running smoothly. Parking was a bit of a challenge, so we ended up finding a spot on the street, but it was absolutely worth the short walk. A fantastic spot for delicious food and a lively atmosphere!
The half order of steak nachos was delicious! Our waitress was very attentive. The only down side was the music being really loud, we even had to repeat ourselves while ordering.

We had the most amazing experience at Good Company Seafood! A huge shoutout to Jorge, who absolutely made our night — we loved him! We came in to celebrate my friend’s birthday and the entire team treated us so incredibly well. The hospitality was truly top-notch.
And let’s talk about the food — hands down, the best fajitas in town. No contest. If you haven’t been yet, do yourself a favor and go. You won’t be disappointed!
